# Section H, set H2: printed-paper photos taken by the user's friend (EXPLORATORY)

*Generated by `scripts/analysis/section_H2_paper.py`. Rules: docs/plan/analysis_plan_changes.md, 2026-11-15 night (amendment 1 and the provenance correction). A different photographer and an unknown phone, sent by WhatsApp; NOT the project owner's phone, never pooled with it. Photos matched to pages by image content (SIFT, validated on 16 of 16 header IDs read by eye). bad = no usable heart rate or wrong (> 5 bpm, cleaned measure). The two photos of a page are not independent. V0 = photo as taken; V2a = frozen finder on the photo as taken; V2b = orientation step + frozen finder.*
